scope: All 272 major sets audited; ordinary supported base frames sampled, old first. Reserved distinct names; frame-only per-scan normalization. Special layouts/effects/crowns and missing references remain explicit. No per-card rendering adjustments.
limitations: Stratified samples; not every-card accuracy coverage.
Affine comparison stretch does not certify source-frame aspect.
Frame rail shifts are source-asset diagnostics, not automatically adopted deformations.
No glyph contour or frame asset is synthesized to conceal a mismatch.
Special layouts/effects and modern crowns remain separate adapters.
